request.initial_prompt: [Now will I question Cassio of Bianca, A housewife that by selling her desires Buys herself bread and clothes: it is a creature That dotes on Cassio, (as 'tis the strumpet's plague To beguile many and be beguil'd by one.) He, when he hears of her, cannot refrain From the excess of laughter. Here he comes.]
